fields.title: Narrate can read a footnote where it is referenced
fields.description: Owner request 2026-11-03: a Narrate setting, "Read footnotes where they're referenced", off by default. On reaching a note marker ("blah blah 1"), Narrate says "Footnote 1:" and reads the note text, then carries on from the word after the marker. The cursor stays exact-word (owner ruling #31).
fields.notes: origin: owner answer to BLOCK-TEXT-ORDER-1 OQ2, 2026-11-03 (docs/planning/roadmap-reviews/2026-11-03-block-text-order-contracts.md). Needs BLOCK-TEXT-ORDER-1's note-target identification. Stub; design and technical spec to follow.
